# Shubhangi Gupta

> Portfolio of Shubhangi Gupta, Recruitment Manager for South Asia at Luminate
> Education Group. Eight years across India and the UK in international growth,
> sales, partnerships and client engagement.

The whole portfolio is one page. The links below are anchors on it. Each role in
the experience section opens a detail panel in place rather than a new URL, so
the full text of every role is already in the page source.

## Sections

- [Home](https://shubhangigupta.com/): the portfolio, in full, on one page
- [Journey](https://shubhangigupta.com/#journey): six cities, Lucknow to Leeds and back
- [Experience](https://shubhangigupta.com/#experience): Luminate Education Group and Infosys
- [Education](https://shubhangigupta.com/#education): MSc at the University of Leeds, B.Tech at SRM Institute
- [Skills](https://shubhangigupta.com/#skills): market entry, partnerships, delivery
- [Beyond work](https://shubhangigupta.com/#beyond): Robin Hood Army and independent projects
- [Contact](https://shubhangigupta.com/#contact): email and LinkedIn

## Notes

- All content is present in the HTML at load. Nothing meaningful is fetched afterwards.
- Person data is published as schema.org/Person JSON-LD in the document head.
- Contact: guptashubhangi.work@gmail.com
